summary.intent: Decide whether Phase 72 needed discussion before planning, reconcile todo drift across Phases 70-73, confirm 72/73 dependency ordering, and then run Phase 72 through plan → execute → ship.
summary.outcome: Todo drift was resolved (8 Phase 71 todos moved to completed/, zeroize and 68.2-coderabbit-hardening-backlog added to 72/73 source lists) and Phase 72 planning was started, but had to be paused mid-CONTEXT.md-drafting when the user reported three CI regressions; all three were root-caused and fixed (web-e2e floor helper, FUSE seq-equivocation + stale desktop-e2e DTO fields, sdk-e2e Test 21 flake), shipped as PRs #600 and #601, with runtime validation dispatched but not yet fully green at session end.

repo: GSD repo retires todos by moving pending/ files to completed/ (not a resolved/ folder, which stays empty) — Phase 71 shipped (#599) without doing this for its 8 source todos.

ci-e2e.yml (Web E2E + Desktop E2E) only triggers on push-to-main or workflow_dispatch, never on PR — so PR CI never proves an e2e fix; must manually dispatch desktop-e2e.yml/web-e2e.yml against the branch for real validation before merge.
gh workflow dispatch on this repo's workflow definitions rejects `-f ref=<branch>`; use `--ref <branch>` instead.

Phase 71 did a full IPNS/share DTO field rename (readDescriptorRef→encryptedReadKey, rootIpnsName→shareRootIpnsName) but missed updating tests/desktop-e2e/scripts/*.mts drivers, causing stale-field 400s.
Phase 70.1 collapsed two IndexedDB stores (generation-high-water, seq-high-water) into one `rotation-floor` store (DB `cipherbox-rotation-state` v2, keyed by nodeId) — old store names are gone.

code.finding: publish_file_node hardcoded seq=1 on the first-publish branch (gated on 'inode cid empty'); a re-key/CID change on retry re-triggered seq=1 and tripped Phase 71's anti-equivocation gate. Fixed by resolving IPNS name first and falling through to the existing CAS-bump path on Found instead of skipping.

Anti-equivocation gate rejects same-sequence republish with a different CID (D-05); same-CID idempotent republish still succeeds — this idempotency is what made sdk-e2e Test 21's strict 'exactly one 409' assertion flaky.
Test helper still probed the old (pre-Phase-70.1) IndexedDB store names, silently returning generation: undefined instead of reading the merged rotation-floor store.

Test 21 (D-06 concurrent first-publish) asserted exactly one 200 + one 409, but same-CID same-seq concurrent publishes can legitimately both return 200 under Phase 71 idempotency — rewritten to accept either outcome shape while still rejecting 5xx or an unbounded winner count.

workflow: Fan out read-only diagnostic agents to pull failing-test signatures/root causes from huge CI logs rather than reading full logs inline, keeping main context clean.
When pausing in-progress uncommitted work to handle an interruption, `git stash` it and switch to a clean branch off main rather than committing prematurely or losing it.
Before trusting an agent's proposed patch on unfamiliar/production code (DB schema, Rust FFI signatures), independently verify the real schema/signatures before applying.

friction: gsd-plan-phase execution was interrupted mid-CONTEXT.md drafting by an out-of-band CI failure report, requiring a full context switch and stash.
Initial `gh workflow dispatch -f ref=<branch>` calls were rejected; had to discover the `--ref` flag form works instead.
Desktop E2E dispatch run returned failures on Windows/Linux while macOS was still pending, complicating diagnosis of whether the fuse fix actually worked.
Web-e2e dispatch run showed 2 failures in unrelated specs (full-workflow, writable-shares), requiring extra digging to confirm they were pre-existing flakes and not caused by the floor-helper fix.
sdk-e2e failed on PR #600 even though the PR's diff only touched a web-e2e spec, requiring a diagnostic pass to establish it was an unrelated pre-existing flake (Test 21) before fixing it.
Desktop-e2e mount test e2e legs don't run on PRs at all, so both fix PRs initially looked unvalidated and required manual workflow_dispatch to get real runtime proof.
open_items: Re-dispatched desktop-e2e run (with the added .mts DTO-field fix on #601) had not yet reported a result at session end — need to confirm D-16 goes fully green on all OSes.
Web-e2e dispatch's 2 non-target failures (full-workflow.spec.ts 6.6.2, writable-shares.spec.ts 8.1) suspected flakes but not yet confirmed via re-run.
PR #600 now bundles web-e2e + sdk-e2e Test 21 fixes under one `test(web-e2e):` title; user was offered the option to split sdk-e2e fix into its own PR for cleaner history — decision deferred.
Phase 72 planning (CONTEXT.md drafting, SC#2 fail-closed contract, SC#6 walkChildWriteKey design research) is paused and stashed (`stash@{0}`), to resume once #600 and #601 merge.
Phase 73's newly added 68.2-coderabbit-hardening-backlog source todo needs the planner to cherry-pick only items 4 (stale write envelope) and 9 (nav seed race) rather than the whole bundled backlog.
zeroize-file-keys-on-unwrap-error-path was added to Phase 72's source todos but not yet folded into a specific success criterion by the planner.
Recommended merge order (#601 then #600, or either order once both green) not yet executed — merges still pending user go-ahead.
